songs.prompt: Upbeat lo-fi hip hop at 114 BPM for a dance battle in a cozy hometown bedroom on a November afternoon. Punchy dusty boom-bap drums with crisp straight hi-hats and ghost-note snares, a bouncy round bass line, warm Rhodes chords, a catchy plucked electric guitar hook, soft vinyl crackle, short wordless vocal chops and hand claps on two and four. Playful, hopeful, a little nostalgic. Instrumental, no sung words. A clear, steady backbeat pulse, tight and quantized, from the first second with a short two-bar intro, then a full groove, a short breakdown and a bigger, busier final section that ends cleanly on the beat. Bright, punchy, modern mix with many layers.
